## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. For browser changes, include Chrome and
Phase Pal versions and any checks still needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Tests or manual checks cover the changed behavior, where needed.
- [ ] No private chats, credentials, connection codes, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Existing licenses and attribution are preserved.
